top_signals.title: US Stocks Drop as Semiconductor Rout Batters Market
top_signals.summary: The S&P 500 Index slipped on Tuesday, while a decline in chipmakers dragged tech-focused indexes sharply lower. Traders were awaiting key mega-cap tech earnings and the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision later this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
